Chat-model price-performance frontier

Score axis: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. Cost: USD per 1M tokens, 3:1 input:output blend (list price).

Every score comes from a named external source (listed at the end) with its own snapshot date. Conclave runs no evaluations, and a model with no external score is listed as unscored, never estimated.

Score vs cost

  • On the frontier (filled)
  • Dominated (hollow)
  • Self-reported (diamond)
  • Frontier step line

Cost is the list price in USD per million tokens, blended 3:1 input to output. It is a price-sheet figure: what a task costs also depends on how many tokens a model spends on it, which list price does not show.
